summary: The exact candidate fixes the original default Qwen3.5 GPTQ-Marlin load path. For the reported 96-wide TP-local BA projection it creates an unquantized merged layer, allowing the checkpoint's separate BF16 in_proj_b and in_proj_a tensors to load instead of constructing missing packed parameters and reaching an invalid Marlin repack. Independent metadata, construction, loading, boundary, and gfx950 numerical checks support acceptance.

tests.what_was_measured: Failing-before reproduction: incompatible TP-local widths 96 and 48 retained GPTQ-Marlin; 2 tests failed and 3 controls passed. Raw log: reports/j-5a1612f34970/raw/base-regression.log
16 focused tests passed, covering candidate width/TP selection and existing packed-loader and exclusion behavior. Raw log: reports/j-5a1612f34970/raw/candidate-focused-tests.log

tests.command: HIP_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0 /tmp/amdpilot-repo-j-5a1612f34970/venv/bin/python < independent BF16 BA load and numerical script (candidate 0b57a72)
tests.what_was_measured: A real unquantized 96x128 merged projection loaded separate BF16 B/A shards and executed on gfx950; output shape was (17, 96) and maximum absolute error against torch.nn.functional.linear was 0.0. Raw log: reports/j-5a1612f34970/raw/gpu-bf16-execution.log

Confirmed automatic gptq_marlin selection, compatible-width preservation, dynamic exclusion behavior, and unquantized construction for every valid TP divisor of 48 heads. Raw log: reports/j-5a1612f34970/raw/adversarial-config-cases.log

tests.command: fetch and inspect public config.json and model.safetensors.index.json
tests.what_was_measured: Confirmed 48 BF16 A weights, 48 BF16 B weights, zero BA qweights, and packed QKV/Z weights with the reported GPTQ configuration. Raw log: reports/j-5a1612f34970/raw/checkpoint-metadata-summary.log

gpu_execution_evidence: reports/j-5a1612f34970/raw/gpu-bf16-execution.log records execution on AMD Instinct MI355X gfx950:sramecc+:xnack- and an exact independent numerical match.
remaining_limitations: The available architecture was AMD gfx950, not NVIDIA Ada; the native NVIDIA Marlin repack kernel and exact exception were not executed.
The full 27B checkpoint shards were not downloaded and the complete HTTP serving path was not launched; full-model semantics and distributed execution remain unverified.
No native source changed, so a native rebuild was not applicable.
The candidate's own report references raw logs absent from its commit; this review used independently retained logs instead.
Explicitly forcing the removed non-Marlin gptq backend is unsupported in this prepared environment; the reported default command automatically selects gptq_marlin.
